description: Tax is computed on the full subtotal instead of the amount after discounts.
report_specific: In build_quote, a cart with 2 x $12.00 mugs shipped to US-NY with a 10 percent coupon shows tax of $1.92. Tax should be $1.73 because it must be charged on the price after the discount.
report_vague: Customers who use a promo code or buy in bulk are charged more sales tax than they should. The order totals look too high.
